applicationProfile.name: Photo Album
applicationProfile.description: A simple photo storage and gallery application built with Spring Boot and Oracle DB

critical.title: Java 8 End of Life
critical.description: Application is using Java 8 which reached End of Life in March 2022. This version no longer receives public security updates.
critical.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17 LTS (Long-Term Support) or Java 21 LTS. Java 17 provides significant performance improvements and security enhancements.
critical.migrationPath: Update maven.compiler.source and maven.compiler.target to 17 in pom.xml

critical.title: No Authentication/Authorization
critical.description: Application has no security layer. All endpoints are publicly accessible without authentication.
critical.recommendation: Implement Spring Security with OAuth2/JWT for authentication and role-based access control.
critical.securityRisk: Anyone can upload, view, or delete photos

critical.title: Dangerous Database Schema Management
critical.description: spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is set to 'create' which drops and recreates all tables on application restart.
critical.recommendation: Use 'validate' for production, 'none' for fully managed schemas, or use database migration tools like Flyway/Liquibase.
critical.dataRisk: All data will be lost on application restart

high.title: Spring Boot 2.7 End of Support
high.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x reached end of commercial support in November 2023. Only critical security patches are provided.
high.recommendation: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.2.x (latest stable). Requires Java 17+ and migration to Jakarta EE namespace.
affectedFiles: All Java classes with javax imports
high.migrationPath: Change javax.* imports to jakarta.*, update dependencies

high.title: Binary Data Stored in Database
high.description: Photos are stored as BLOBs in Oracle database. This approach doesn't scale well and increases database backup/restore times.
high.recommendation: Migrate to cloud object storage (Azure Blob Storage, AWS S3) or distributed file system.
high.scalabilityImpact: Database size will grow linearly with photo uploads

high.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
high.description: Database username and password are hardcoded in application.properties files.
high.recommendation: Use environment variables or cloud secret management services (Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager).

high.title: No Test Coverage
high.description: Application has test infrastructure but no actual test cases. PhotoAlbumApplicationTests.java is empty.
high.recommendation: Implement comprehensive test suite with unit tests (80%+ coverage) and integration tests.

medium.title: Missing Health and Readiness Probes
medium.description: Application lacks health check endpoints for Kubernetes liveness/readiness probes.
medium.recommendation: Add spring-boot-starter-actuator dependency and configure health endpoints.

medium.title: No Structured Logging
medium.description: Application uses System.out logging, not suitable for cloud environments.
medium.recommendation: Configure Logback with JSON output format and integrate with cloud logging services.
medium.observabilityGap: Difficult to aggregate and analyze logs

medium.title: No Metrics Collection
medium.description: Application doesn't expose metrics for Prometheus or other monitoring systems.
medium.recommendation: Add Micrometer dependencies and configure metrics export.

medium.title: Oracle-Specific SQL Queries
medium.description: Repository uses Oracle-specific functions (TO_CHAR, ROWNUM) which reduces database portability.
medium.recommendation: Use JPA Criteria API or Spring Data JPA pagination instead of native queries.
medium.portabilityImpact: Cannot easily switch to PostgreSQL, MySQL, or other databases

medium.title: File Upload Validation Gaps
medium.description: File upload only validates MIME type and size. No content validation or malware scanning.
medium.recommendation: Implement file content validation, image format verification, and consider virus scanning integration.

low.title: No REST API Layer
low.description: Application only provides MVC endpoints, no REST API for programmatic access.
low.recommendation: Add REST controllers with proper API versioning for modern client applications.
low.futureProofing: Enables mobile apps and third-party integrations

low.title: No Caching Strategy
low.description: Application doesn't cache frequently accessed photos or metadata.
low.recommendation: Implement Redis or Caffeine cache for photo metadata and thumbnails.
low.performanceGain: Reduced database load and faster response times

low.title: Commons IO Version
low.description: Using commons-io 2.11.0 from February 2022. Latest is 2.15.1 (January 2024).
low.recommendation: Update to latest version 2.15.1 for bug fixes and improvements.

containerization.notes: Application is fully containerized with Docker and Docker Compose

statelessness.notes: Application is stateless except for database persistence

configuration.notes: Configuration is hardcoded, not externalized. Doesn't follow 12-factor principles

security.notes: No authentication, authorization, or security measures implemented

observability.notes: Basic console logging only. No structured logs, metrics, or tracing

scalability.notes: Database BLOB storage limits horizontal scaling

portability.notes: Uses Oracle-specific queries. Framework is portable

resilience.notes: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or health checks

phases.name: Critical Security & Runtime Updates
tasks: Externalize all configuration to environment variables

phases.name: Cloud Infrastructure Optimization
tasks: Migrate photo storage from Oracle BLOBs to Azure Blob Storage / AWS S3
Add Spring Boot Actuator for health checks
Integrate with cloud secret management (Azure Key Vault)

phases.name: Observability & Monitoring
tasks: Add Micrometer metrics with Prometheus export
Implement distributed tracing with Spring Cloud Sleuth
Configure application insights or equivalent APM

phases.name: API & Performance Enhancements
tasks: Create REST API layer with OpenAPI documentation
Implement Redis caching for photo metadata
Add async processing for image uploads
Replace Oracle-specific queries with portable JPA

services: Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Replace Oracle

summary.recommendedAction: Application requires significant modernization before cloud deployment. Priority areas: security implementation, runtime version upgrades, and storage architecture redesign.
keyWeaknesses: Outdated Java and Spring Boot versions
